episodes.synopsis: In Roanapur, the new head of the Lovelace family makes an offer to Rock and the Lagoon Company, while the vengeful Roberta appears seeking weapons.
episodes.title: Collateral Massacre

episodes.synopsis: Rock searches for Roberta even as she accumulates the equipment she needs to wage war. Roanapur's crime lords meet to discuss the volatile situation.
episodes.title: An Office Man's Tactics

episodes.synopsis: Roberta engages in combat with U.S. soldiers as well as FARC fighters, one of whom tries to recruit her into their cause. Garcia tries to intervene.
episodes.title: Angels in the Crosshairs

episodes.synopsis: Rock and Chang ask Dutch and the Lagoon Company to get the Americans out of town, while Roberta continues her attacks.
episodes.title: Oversaturation Kill Box

episodes.synopsis: The Black Lagoon arrives in the Golden Triangle, where the Americans are attacked by Roberta, leading to a final confrontation.
episodes.title: Codename Paradise, Status MIA
